note: Asking prices in euros from the original listing on the day each home was added. Medians describe the homes RealHunt lists (cheap for their country, checked by a person), not a country's whole market. Rules, taxes and costs are general information, not legal or tax advice.
sentences: On 28 November 2026, RealHunt lists 3 homes for sale in Turkey, each one checked by a person.
In Turkey, the median asking price of those 3 homes is €179,000 (€881 per m², from the 3 homes with a known size); the cheapest costs €161,533 and the most expensive €185,000.
With 3 homes this is a small sample, so the median for Turkey is a rough guide.

homes.title: Furnished villa with private pool and garden in Alanya, Antalya
homes.title_es: Villa amueblada con piscina privada y jardín en Alanya, Antalya
homes.summary: This fully furnished villa offers 250 m2 of living space with two bedrooms and two bathrooms. It also has two separate WCs and brand-new air conditioning units. The large terrace has views from the south-west to the north, and the property includes a private pool and a secluded garden. Secure indoor parking is included, and the sea is 1.5 km away. Asking €161,533, about €646/m².

homes.title: Move-in ready furnished 3-bedroom villa with pool and plot in Belek, Antalya
homes.title_es: Villa amueblada lista para entrar a vivir con piscina y parcela en Belek, Antalya
homes.summary: This move-in ready semi-detached villa is fully furnished and ready to live in. It has 3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, a living room with open kitchen and 3 balconies, plus a storage area. It sits in a complex of 8 villas with a shared pool, on a 1574 m² plot. It has air conditioners, PVC windows and shutters, and internet access. The beach is 1.5 km away, the golf course 2 km, and Antalya Airport 31 km. Asking €185,000, about €881/m².

homes.title: Move-in ready 3-bedroom semi-detached villa with pool and views in Alanya, Antalya
homes.title_es: Villa adosada de 3 dormitorios lista para entrar a vivir con piscina y vistas en Alanya, Antalya
homes.summary: This move-in ready semi-detached villa was built in 2006 and spans three floors. It has 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, and white goods and furniture are included. Outdoor features include a garden, a spacious terrace, a big balcony, a pool with a children's pool, and views of the castle, city and sea. The property has open car parking, bicycle parking, camera surveillance and concierge service. It is 5 km from the city centre and beaches, and 140 metres from the airport. Asking €179,000, about €1,193/m².
